class.name: CloudsConfig
class.brief_description: Configuration of a cloud layer for [VolumetricCloudsEffect].
class.description: Describes a cloud layer as a spherical shell around a planet, along with the quality settings it is ray marched with. Setting a property to a value outside of its valid range prints an error and leaves the previous value in place.

members.member: Altitude above the planet's surface at which the cloud layer starts. Cannot be negative.
Altitude above the planet's surface at which the cloud layer ends. Must be greater than [member cloud_inner_height], otherwise the layer has no thickness.
World space distance after which the cloud noise repeats. Larger values give larger clouds.
How much of the layer is filled with clouds, from [code]0.1[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].
Scales the density of the clouds, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].
Number of samples taken towards the sun to light each cloud sample, from [code]1[/code] to [code]10[/code].
Base number of steps each view ray is marched with, from [code]1[/code] to [code]256[/code].
Distance from the camera past which clouds are no longer rendered.
World space position of the center of the planet.
Radius of the planet's surface. The cloud heights are measured from it.
The clouds are ray marched at the viewport's resolution divided by this value, from [code]1[/code] to [code]4[/code], and then upsampled.
Seed the cloud noise is generated with.
